title: Differentiation of Pure Cortical Neurons from Human iPSCs
author: Dannert, Klimmt, et al.

steps.title: Prepare coating solutions and coat plates
steps.instruction: Make all coating solutions on ice, dilute in cold diluent, and coat the appropriate plates according to the specifications below.

substeps.instruction: Vitronectin: use stock 0.5 mg/mL; dilute 1:100 in PBS; add enough to cover each well; incubate ≥1 h at room temperature (RT); store coated plates at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks.
Geltrex (GTX): use original concentration 12–18 mg/mL; dilute 1:150 in DMEM‑F12; incubate ≥1 h at 37 °C (followed by 1 h at RT if possible); store at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks.
Poly‑L‑Ornithine (PO): resuspend 100 mg in 20 mL sterile MilliQ water to obtain 5 mg/mL stock; dilute 1:100 in sterile MilliQ water; incubate ≥4 h at RT; store at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks.

Laminin (L): use original 1 mg/mL; dilute 1:100 in PBS; first pre‑treat plates with PO as above, aspirate PO, add Laminin solution, incubate ≥12 h at RT; plates coated with PO + L are called POL‑coated; store POL‑coated plates at 4 °C for up to 2 weeks and prepare fresh plates for the high‑density spot split.

steps.title: Prepare Neuronal Differentiation Medium (NM)
steps.instruction: Mix the following components to a final volume of 500 mL, filter‑sterilize, and store at 4 °C for up to 3 weeks. Add bFGF to a final concentration of 20 ng/µL just before use.

substeps.instruction: Neurobasal (1×) – 0.5×, 237 mL
Penicillin (10 000 U/mL)/Streptomycin (10 mg/mL) – 100 U/mL and 0.1 mg/mL, 5 mL
B27 supplement (50×, with Vit. A) – 0.5×, 5 mL
GlutaMAX (200 mM) – 2 mM, 5 mL
N‑2 supplement (100×) – 0.5×, 2.5 mL
Insulin (500 µg/mL) – 2.5 µg/mL, 2.5 mL
2‑Mercaptoethanol (55 mM) – 0.05 mM, 455 µL

steps.title: Prepare Neural Induction Medium (NI)
steps.instruction: Combine the components below to a final volume of 50 mL, store at 4 °C for up to 5 days.

steps.title: Prepare Neuronal Maintenance Medium (NB+/B27+)
steps.instruction: Make 250 mL of the following, store at 4 °C for up to 4 weeks, and add the indicated small‑molecule supplements immediately before use.

substeps.instruction: Neurobasal PLUS (1×) – 1×, 242 mL
GlutaMAX (200 mM) – 0.5 mM, 0.625 mL
Penicillin (10 000 U/mL)/Streptomycin (10 mg/mL) – 100 U/mL and 0.1 mg/mL, 2.5 mL
Add DAPT to a final concentration of 10 µM
Add 5‑Fluorouracil to a final concentration of 5 µM
Add Uridine to a final concentration of 5 µM

steps.title: Prepare Freeze Medium for Neural Rosettes (same day)
steps.instruction: Mix the following to a total of 10 mL, use immediately for freezing.

substeps.instruction: DMSO (100 %) – 10 % (v/v), 1 mL (handle with gloves)
bFGF (100 µg/mL) – 20 ng/mL, 2 µL

steps.title: Prepare Thawing Medium for Neural Rosettes (same day)
steps.instruction: Combine the components to 10 mL and keep at 4 °C until use.

substeps.instruction: bFGF (100 µg/mL) – 20 ng/mL, 2 µL
RevitaCell Supplement (100×) – 1×, 100 µL

steps.title: Prepare Plating Medium (same day)
steps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of plating medium immediately before plating.

substeps.instruction: DAPT (10 mM) – 10 µM, 10 µL
RevitaCell Supplement (100×) – 1×, 100 µL

steps.title: Prepare optional E6 medium and L‑ascorbic acid‑2‑phosphate stock
steps.instruction: Make E6 medium (500 mL) and a 64 mg/mL L‑ascorbic acid‑2‑phosphate stock for optional gradient steps.

substeps.instruction: E6 medium: DMEM‑F12 (1×) 482 mL, L‑ascorbic acid‑2‑phosphate 64 µg/mL 500 µL (from stock), ITS‑G (100×) 2× 10 mL, HEPES 15 mM 7.5 mL; store at 4 °C ≤2 weeks.
L‑ascorbic acid‑2‑phosphate stock: dissolve 500 mg in 7.81 mL sterile MilliQ water to obtain 64 mg/mL; sterile‑filter, aliquot, store at –20 °C ≤1 year.

steps.title: Prepare optional E6‑NI gradient media
steps.instruction: Prepare two gradient media (12 mL each) for use on DIV0–DIV2 if needed.

substeps.instruction: Gradient medium‑1: E6 (1×) 0.66× 8 mL, NM (1×) 0.33× 4 mL, SB431542 10 µM 12 µL, LDN‑193189 0.25 µM 1.2 µL; store at 4 °C ≤5 days.
Gradient medium‑2: E6 (1×) 0.33× 4 mL, NM (1×) 0.66× 8 mL, SB431542 10 µM 12 µL, LDN‑193189 0.25 µM 1.2 µL; store at 4 °C ≤5 days.

steps.title: Coat plates for iPSC seeding
steps.instruction: Coat vitronectin‑treated 6‑well plates and GTX‑treated 12‑well plates as described in Step 1, using 2–3 GTX‑coated wells per 6‑well plate of iPSCs.

steps.title: Clean iPSC cultures before induction
steps.instruction: Remove any spontaneously differentiated cells from the iPSC culture to keep aberrant differentiation below 5 %.

steps.title: Split iPSCs and initiate neural induction (DIV0)
steps.instruction: When iPSCs reach 70–80 % confluence, dissociate, count, and plate 1 × 10⁶ cells per well of a GTX‑coated 12‑well plate in NI medium containing 10 µM RI.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL Accutase to each well of the 6‑well plate.
Incubate 5–8 min at 37 °C until most cells detach (monitor under microscope).
Add 1 mL DMEM/F12, gently triturate with a P1000 to obtain a single‑cell suspension, and count cells.
Transfer the volume containing 1 × 10⁶ cells into a 15 mL conical tube; centrifuge 4 min at 170 g at RT.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend the pellet in NI medium supplemented with 10 µM RI to a concentration of 1 × 10⁶ cells/mL.
Plate 1 mL (1 × 10⁶ cells) into each GTX‑coated well of a 12‑well plate (≈260 000 cells/cm²).
Gently rock the plate back and forth in two orthogonal directions to evenly distribute cells.

steps.title: Daily NI medium changes until DIV7
steps.instruction: Replace NI medium each day, adjusting volume as the culture grows.

substeps.instruction: Days 0–4: add 1 mL fresh NI medium per well.
Days 5–7: increase to 1.5–2 mL per well to ensure sufficient growth‑factor and nutrient supply.

steps.title: Optional E6‑NI gradient application (DIV0–DIV2)
steps.instruction: For difficult‑to‑differentiate lines, substitute NI medium with the gradient media as follows.

substeps.instruction: DIV0: after the split, add 1 mL E6‑NI gradient medium‑1 instead of NI.
DIV1: change medium to 1 mL E6‑NI gradient medium‑2.
DIV2: change medium to standard NI and continue with the standard protocol.
